findings.title: The step is launch bound
findings.evidence: the device is busy 6% of the step (620 of 9636 ms) over 25434 launches and 541647 operators per step, 373 us of host time per launch
findings.lever: graph replay is already running for some steps; compare replayed and eager step times above

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.in_layers (up)
findings.evidence: 709.6 ms per step against an ideal 20.7 ms (3% efficient, compute-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 11113 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.skip_connection (up)
findings.evidence: 476.6 ms per step against an ideal 2.5 ms (1% efficient, compute-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 11113 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn1 (up)
findings.evidence: 437.6 ms per step against an ideal 9.8 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 11113 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn2 (up)
findings.evidence: 423.6 ms per step against an ideal 9.8 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 11113 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn1 (down)
findings.evidence: 384.0 ms per step against an ideal 6.5 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 24 layers; all rated pieces together leave 11113 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Dtype and copy kernels take a large share
findings.evidence: 24% of device time is casts and copies
findings.lever: find the modules issuing `.to(dtype)` round trips (autocast boundaries, adapter branches) and keep one dtype through them

findings.title: Many small memory-bound kernels
findings.evidence: 45% of device time (16075 calls per step) is elementwise, normalisation, copy, memory and reduction work
findings.lever: fusion (fewer, larger kernels): norm + modulation, activation + multiply, cast + matmul input; half the time is the most a fusion usually recovers
